requirements.statement: In each form, each field label and its associated field are visually close, so that the relation between them cannot be mistaken.

citations.quote: Chaque étiquette de champ et son champ associé sont-ils accolés ?
Dans chaque formulaire, chaque étiquette de champ et son champ associé sont-ils accolés (hors cas particuliers) ?

routes.statement: The label and the field are visually close enough that their relation cannot be confused.

citations.quote: Il faut que l’étiquette et son champ soient visuellement proches de manière à ce que la relation entre les deux ne puisse pas prêter à confusion.
Pour chaque champ de formulaire, vérifier qu’il est accolé à son étiquette

rationale.text: The glossary defines adjacent as visually close so that the relation between label and field cannot be confused. Whether a distance can be confused depends on the layout around the field, such as other fields and labels nearby, and is judgment; the text gives no distance a check could measure. Code can measure the gap between a <label> and its field, but no gap is a fault under this wording on its own, and a label far from its field but alone in its region may still be unambiguous. So no check is linked and the entry is none. The particular cases of criterion 11.4 name only tests 11.4.2 and 11.4.3, so this test has no exception. The criterion applies in each form, a <form> element or one with role="form". Applicability is judgment: a field whose label is given only by aria-label or title has no displayed label to place, and whether this test then applies to it, or only test 11.1.3, is open. No axe rule is tagged for this test. Needs is empty: positions are read on the page as loaded.

citations.quote: visuellement proches de manière à ce que la relation entre les deux ne puisse pas prêter à confusion
Les tests 11.4.2 et 11.4.3 seront considérés comme non applicables :
Balise <form> ou balise possédant un attribut WAI-ARIA role="form".
